mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_CONTENT ( MEMBER_ID, CONTENT_ID, RATING_SCORE, WATCHLIST, RATED_DT, WATCHLIST_DT, UPDATED_DT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{contentId}, #{ratingScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, NVL(#{watchlist,jdbcType=CHAR}, 'N'), CASE WHEN #{ratingScore,jdbcType=INTEGER} IS NOT NULL THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN NVL(#{watchlist,jdbcType=CHAR}, 'N') = 'Y' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, CONTENT_ID, RATING_SCORE, WATCHLIST, TO_CHAR(RATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS RATED_DT, TO_CHAR(WATCHLIST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WATCHLIST_DT, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_DT FROM MEMBER_CONTENT WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_CONTENT SET RATING_SCORE = #{ratingScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, WATCHLIST = #{watchlist}, RATED_DT = CASE WHEN #{ratingScore,jdbcType=INTEGER} IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN RATING_SCORE IS NULL OR RATING_SCORE <> #{ratingScore,jdbcType=INTEGER} THEN SYSDATE ELSE RATED_DT END, WATCHLIST_DT = CASE WHEN #{watchlist} = 'Y' THEN NVL(WATCHLIST_DT, SYSDATE) ELSE NULL END, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND CONTENT_ID = #{contentId}

SELECT MEMBER_ID, CONTENT_ID, RATING_SCORE, WATCHLIST, RATED_DT, WATCHLIST_DT, UPDATED_DT, TITLE_KO, TITLE_ORG, RELEASE_YEAR, POSTER_URL FROM ( SELECT MC.MEMBER_ID, MC.CONTENT_ID, MC.RATING_SCORE, MC.WATCHLIST, TO_CHAR(MC.RATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS RATED_DT, TO_CHAR(MC.WATCHLIST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS WATCHLIST_DT, TO_CHAR(MC.UPDATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_DT, C.TITLE_KO, C.TITLE_ORG, TO_CHAR(C.RELEASE_YEAR, 'YYYY') AS RELEASE_YEAR, C.POSTER_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY
MC.RATED_DT DESC,
MC.WATCHLIST_DT DESC,
MC.UPDATED_DT DESC,
MC.MEMBER_ID DESC, MC.CONTENT_ID DESC ) AS RNUM FROM MEMBER_CONTENT MC JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_ID = MC.CONTENT_ID
)
WHERE RNUM BETWEEN ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) AND (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize})
ORDER BY RNUM
